title: Proxmox overview
description: The PVE nodes, guests and storages at a glance, from pvestatd's stats in Prometheus.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.description: The lylat cluster (every node but greatfox) or the standalone greatfox.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Nodes that reported within the last minute of the time range (Up) and nodes seen earlier in the range that stopped reporting (Down).

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: Running VMs and containers, stopped guests (templates not counted) and templates.

targets.expr: count(pvestatd_system_running{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"} == 0 unless on (object, vmid, nodename) pvestatd_system_template{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Busy share of all node cores (pvestatd's cpu, weighted by cores).

targets.expr: sum(pvestatd_cpustat_cpu{object="nodes", host${cluster}"greatfox"} * pvestatd_cpustat_cpus{object="nodes", host${cluster}"greatfox"}) / sum(pvestatd_cpustat_cpus{object="nodes", host${cluster}"greatfox"})

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used / total memory over all nodes (used = total - available).

panels.title: Allocated to running guests
panels.description: vCPUs and configured memory of the running guests, against the nodes' cores and RAM. Above 1x vCPUs is normal overcommit; memory near 100% leaves no room for an HA failover.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Last values in the time range. State is DOWN when the node stopped reporting. Network is the current rate summed over the physical NICs. Click a node for its dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (host) (present_over_time(pvestatd_cpustat_avg1{object="nodes", host${cluster}"greatfox"}[1m])) or max by (host) (last_over_time(pvestatd_cpustat_avg1{object="nodes", host${cluster}"greatfox"}[$__range])) * 0

panels.title: Load (5m) per core
panels.description: 5-minute load average divided by the node's cores; above 1 means runnable tasks are waiting.

panels.title: Network per node (physical NICs)
panels.description: Summed over each node's physical NICs (bond members and uplinks); one color per node, inbound up (solid), outbound down (dashed).

panels.title: IO wait per node
panels.description: Share of CPU time spent waiting for I/O.

panels.title: Top guests by CPU
panels.description: Share of each guest's own vCPUs in use.

panels.title: Top guests by memory
panels.description: Host memory used by the guest (memhost for VMs, mem for containers).

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (host, vmid) (pvestatd_system_memhost{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"} or pvestatd_system_mem{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) > 0)

panels.title: Guest CPU by node (cores)
panels.description: Cores busy running guests, per node.

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Used / total. Shared storages once, local ones per node.

targets.expr: max by (storage) (label_replace(max by (host) ((max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_used{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) / (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_total{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) > 0)) and on (host, nodename) (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_shared{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) == 1)), "storage", "$1", "host", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_join((max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_used{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) / (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_total{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) > 0)) and on (host, nodename) (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_shared{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) == 0), "storage", " (", "host", "nodename"), "storage", "$1)", "storage", "(.+)"))

max by (storage) (label_replace(max by (host) ((max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_used{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) / (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_total{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) > 0)) and on (host, nodename) (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_shared{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) == 1)), "storage", "$1", "host", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_join((max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_used{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) / (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_total{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) > 0)) and on (host, nodename) (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_shared{object="storages", nodename${cluster}"greatfox"}) == 0), "storage", " (", "host", "nodename"), "storage", "$1)", "storage", "(.+)"))
